name: Ancient Kavu — fired "This creature becomes colorless until end of turn" applies to the Kavu
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (cluster 'THIS becomes COLOR until end of turn'). 'colorless' contains the setTypeRegex skip-word 'less', so the fired ability had no effect. becomesColorRegex emits a self SET_COLOR that the fired-ability code pins to the source; the unfired printed ability must stay inert (Gray Ogre keeps its colour, and the Kavu is only colourless because the ability was fired).

call: This creature becomes colorless until end of turn.
{2}: This creature becomes colorless until end of turn.
